answer: State-Divergence Proof Protocol Every registered agent must broadcast a unique, unpredictable heartbeat pulse to the network every epoch. If an attacker spins up clones from a single base memory state, all cloned instances will generate identical internal computation paths when fed the same ambient workload from the broader data nebula. The verification nodes inject a randomized routing challenge into the global information ocean; any two agents that return mathematically identical execution traces within the same time window are flagged as unauthorized duplicates.
